subject: Champion appreciation — gifting, charity receipt & logistics
messages:
From: Elise Turner <elise.turner@brightbox.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Champion appreciation — next steps

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the case study offer — our marketing team is excited. We would love the advocate package to include a $250 digital gift card (Visa or Amazon), and for the company to make a $250 donation to the San Jose Youth Coding Fund in our name. For procurement, I've attached BrightBox's W-9 and the org's charity EIN if you need it for receipts.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm you can issue a donation receipt addressed to BrightBox Inc. (EIN: 94-1234567)?
- For the physical swag, we prefer a small desk kit (branded notebook + mug). Ship to our office (address below).

Office address:
BrightBox Inc.
Attn: Dan Chavez
1888 Market St, Suite 301
San Jose, CA 95113

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps coordinate.

Best,
Elise
Director of Partnerships
BrightBox Inc.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elise Turner <elise.turner@brightbox.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Champion appreciation — next steps

Hi Elise,

Thanks — this is great. We're happy to proceed. Quick notes from our side:
- We can issue a $250 donor receipt and list BrightBox Inc. as the donor; finance needs the EIN you included.
- Gift card: we can send an e-gift card to the advocate (please confirm preferred provider: Amazon or Visa). If you prefer Visa, we'll need the advocate's mailing address or email for delivery.
- Swag pack: we'll ship the notebook + mug. I will confirm dimensions for shipping; our logistics partner charges $12 ground per small package.

Ben / Marissa, can you confirm a charge code for the $250 honorarium + $12 shipping and the donation nominal ledger so we can process internally? Also, Monica — can you generate the donation receipt pdf once finance confirms?

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Champion appreciation — next steps

Looping in finance ops for coding.

Charge allocation proposal:
- Honorarium (gift card) $250 -> CS Marketing promo budget (GL: 5402)
- Donation $250 -> Corporate giving (GL: 6807)
- Shipping $12 -> Promo shipping (GL: 5410)

Marissa, approve the promo spend? Monica, once approved I will route payment and confirm donation receipt once the charity issues it. Also note: for tax purposes we need BrightBox's billing address to put on the internal invoice. Elise — can you share the billing address (if different from the shipping address)?

Thanks,
Ben
Sales Operations
